raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely assumed that “Rostov” referred to Rostov-on-Don (“by common disambiguation”) and proceeded on that basis without verification, despite sources indicating John the Hairy was a 16th-century figure associated with Rostov (Rostov the Great/Rostov Veliky). Rostov-on-Don did not exist at that time, whereas Rostov Veliky (in Yaroslavl Oblast) did. This unsupported disambiguation led toward the wrong territorial entity (Rostov Oblast instead of the correct Yaroslavl Oblast).
